# List and tree search highlighting throws on regex metacharacters

## Context

Grace's defect-note (2026-11-03, found while reviewing #20244): typing `(` in the Docs app's navigation search throws in the App worker. Promoted after reproducing it through the engine path, not only `new RegExp('(')`.

## The Problem

`Neo.tree.List#filter` and the list highlighters build a `RegExp` from the raw search value, so every regex metacharacter changes the search. A unit probe at dev `3ed29de673`, a `tree.List` with leaves `Child (1)` and `Other.thing`:

```
filter('name', '(')            → SyntaxError: Invalid regular expression: /(/gi: Unterminated group
filter('name', '[')            → SyntaxError: Invalid regular expression: /[/gi: Unterminated character class
filter('name', '+' | '?' | '*') → SyntaxError: Invalid regular expression: /+/gi: Nothing to repeat (same for ? and *)
filter('name', 'Child (1')     → SyntaxError: Invalid regular expression: /Child (1/gi: Unterminated group
filter('name', '.')            → both leaves stay visible, though only `Other.thing` contains a dot
```

Who sees it:
- The Docs app's navigation search: `docs/app/view/MainContainerController.mjs#onNavigationSearchFieldChange` passes the field value straight to both tree lists. The Portal embeds the Docs app. Measured through the engine path above, not in a browser.
- By code reading only (not run): a filtering `ComboBox` whose list highlights matches. `highlightFilterValue` defaults to `true` on `Neo.list.Base`; the combo's list Store filter on the display field uses `filterOperator: 'like'`, and `createItemContent` builds a `RegExp` from the same value.

## The Architectural Reality

- `src/tree/List.mjs#filter`: `valueRegEx = hasValue ? new RegExp(value, 'gi') : null` both decides `directMatch` and wraps matches in `neo-highlight-search` spans.
- `src/list/Base.mjs#createItemContent` and `src/list/Country.mjs#createItemContent`: `new RegExp(filter.value, 'gi')` for the highlight.
- `src/collection/Filter.mjs` `like`: `a.toLowerCase().includes(b.toLowerCase())`. The Store filter these highlighters decorate is a literal, case-insensitive substring match, so the highlight and the match disagree.
- `src/util/String.mjs` (`Neo.util.String`) already holds the text escapers (`escapeHtml`, `unescapeHtml`); there is no regex escaper in `src/`.
- Design authority: the option-search contract of D#19646, as #19670 records it: "Case-insensitive literal label substring", with "case-sensitive or regex search" out of scope. No JSDoc on `tree.List#filter` or `highlightFilterValue` asks for regex semantics.

## The Fix

Treat the search value as literal text in all three places, keeping the `gi` flags (case-insensitive, every occurrence):

1. Add `Neo.util.String.escapeRegExp(value)`, which escapes every regex metacharacter, with JSDoc and a unit spec.
2. Build the pattern from the escaped value in `tree.List#filter`, `list.Base#createItemContent` and `list.Country#createItemContent`.

The tree's `directMatch` then means "the name contains the value", which is what `like` means for the Store.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1 `Neo.util.String.escapeRegExp()` escapes `\ ^ $ . * + ? ( ) [ ] { } |` (and `/`, `-` where the pattern needs it), covered by a unit spec.
- [ ] AC-2 `tree.List#filter` with `(`, `[`, `+`, `?`, `*` and `Child (1` filters without throwing; `.` keeps only names containing a dot; every case-insensitive occurrence is still highlighted. Unit spec in `test/playwright/unit/tree/List.spec.mjs`, red on dev, green at head.
- [ ] AC-3 `list.Base` and `list.Country` render an item whose Store filter value is `(` without throwing, highlighting the literal match. Unit spec.
- [ ] AC-4 A browser witness: in the Docs app, typing `(` into the navigation search filters by that literal text, with no error in the App worker. Red on dev, green at head.

## Out of Scope

- Regex search as a feature (D#19646 ruled it out).
- Escaping item text that is rendered as `html`: a separate, pre-existing question.
- Case-sensitive search.

## Avoided Traps

- Catching the `SyntaxError` and falling back: `.` and `*` would still silently mean "anything", and the highlight would still disagree with `like`.
- `RegExp.escape`: an option where the engine's browser floor allows it; the helper works everywhere and is unit-testable on its own.

## Related

#20244 (where it was found), #3240, #19670, D#19646.

## Intake Sharpening & Contract Ledger (`#20277`)

### Prescription & Surface-Anchor V-B-A
- `Prescription checked: src/util/String.mjs` (`Neo.util.String`) — owns text/entity escaping utilities (`escapeHtml`, `unescapeHtml`). Adding `static regExpMetaPattern = /[\\^$.*+?()[\]{}|/\-]/g` and `static escapeRegExp(value)` (returning non-string values unchanged, matching `escapeHtml` / `unescapeHtml`) keeps all string-escaping primitives in one utility class.
- `Prescription checked: src/tree/List.mjs#filter` — builds `valueRegEx = hasValue ? new RegExp(StringUtil.escapeRegExp(String(value)), 'gi') : null` once at the root call (or per level via escaped `value`) so regex metacharacters (`(`, `[`, `+`, `?`, `*`, `.`, etc.) are matched and highlighted as literal case-insensitive substrings, consistent with `Neo.collection.Filter#like` and `D#19646` / `#19670`.
- `Prescription checked: src/list/Base.mjs#createItemContent` & `src/list/Country.mjs#createItemContent` — builds `new RegExp(StringUtil.escapeRegExp(String(filter.value)), 'gi')` when `highlightFilterValue` is active and `filter.value` is non-empty.
